Aug 19, 2025

Playmaker Sports Summer Championship Heats Up Moorpark

Over 90 teams from across Southern California gathered at Arroyo Vista Park in Moorpark for the Playmaker Sports Summer Championship. Two-time MLS Cup Champion Bryan Jordan joined to hand out medals and sign autographs.

By Playmaker Sports

More than 90 teams from across Southern California arrived at Arroyo Vista Park in Moorpark for the Playmaker Sports Summer Championship. The two-day event delivered a packed schedule of group matches and finals in warm summer conditions.

Two-time MLS Cup champion Bryan Jordan joined the tournament to present medals, meet players, and sign autographs. His visit gave young athletes a chance to celebrate their weekend with someone who competed at the highest level of the American game.

The tournament was built to combine competitive soccer with a welcoming event atmosphere for players and families. Coaches, referees, volunteers, and staff worked across the venue to keep matches moving and make the championship experience memorable.

Playmaker Sports is grateful to every club and family that took part. The Summer Championship continues to grow as a place for teams to test themselves, finish the season together, and celebrate the game.
